sloka: स वृक्षेण हतस्तेन सक्रोधेन महात्मना ।राक्षशो वानरेन्द्रेण पपात च ममार च ।। ६.५६.३० ।।।।
transliteration: sa vṛkṣeṇa hatastena sakrodhena mahātmanā ।rākṣaśo vānarendreṇa papāta ca mamāra ca ।। 6.56.30 ।।।।

translations.english: Reacting in anger the great Vanara chief struck the Rakshasa with a tree, by which the Rakshasa fell down dead.
